review_evidence: ArithDiffCheck and RlpDiffCheck define reference semantics, parsers/checkers, case structures, and generated corpora used for semantic comparison.

RunBlockLayoutBridge contains proof examples; GuestImageShapeDump defines control-flow analysis over Lean Programs; correspondence modules define reusable Subject/Record registries and semantic comparison functions.
The source-owned formal and executable specification content makes a path-name-based Tests exclusion unsafe.
summary: Reviewed the EvmAsm/Tests unit; retain all files because these tests own semantic reference functions, correspondence subjects/records, executable specifications, and proof examples rather than mere runner scaffolding.
